text: The Upbit->Coinone 1m lead is real but too small and too short for taker-taker execution: matched-null excess is only 1.3-2.9 bp at 5 min (z 4-11) with the information horizon at 1 min, i.e. below the 4 bp coinone_conservative round trip. Part of the 1-min excess may also be a stale-last-trade artefact on thin Coinone bars rather than an executable price. Only per-event moves larger than the cost floor (bigger Upbit impulses) or cheaper execution could convert it.
evidence: fact-000001 configs: excess_bp 1.26-2.87 at best primary horizon 5, net_bp[coinone_conservative] -1.25..-2.86, info_h 1 for all 8 configs
research/reports/data_audit_20261109.md (lockbox none, Val none): Coinone 1m flat-bar share 18-33%, Upbit(t-1)->Coinone(t) corr 0.06-0.12
proposed_test: 1m screen (same family) of upbit_lead_impulse thr_bp 40 (block-grid value) k {1,3} with session_kst all_but_quiet: refuted if net mean at 5-15 min is still <= 0 with >= 300 events; plus forward orderbook check that the entry open price was actually executable.
reexamine_if: Coinone fee/cost model changes (maker fills or lower slippage measured on forward orderbook)

text: The 5m Upbit-impulse (40 bp) signal on Coinone is a fading, mostly early-Dev phenomenon: the strategy had 572 Dev trades but only 33 in the last 12 months (G1 recent-sample fail) and 6-month rolling positive fraction 0.47, consistent with the Coinone-Upbit gap tails shrinking from 2021 to 2025. The mechanism (Coinone lag) may persist but large lags are now too rare to trade.

text: Mean reversion after 96-bar Bollinger lows carries information (both cluster representatives beat the trade-count-matched null, G2 p 0.001) but the converted strategy is weak and time-concentrated: Dev Sharpe 0.5-0.9, 6-month rolling positive fraction 0.43-0.55, recent-12m Sharpe 1.6-1.7, heavy tails (kurtosis 20-43). The ATR exits (TP 3 / SL 5 ATR) likely truncate the 120-240 min drift the event study measured, and the cluster picked z 3.0 rather than the screen's strongest config (z 2.5 + trend, net 12.6 bp at 120 min).
evidence: fact-000005 candidates: sharpe_w 0.886 / 0.485, G4 rolling_frac_positive 0.547 / 0.434, G3 neighbor_median 0.708 / 0.165, G5 dsr 0.764 / 0.61, pbo 0.448
fact-000004 (screen camp-000004): bollinger_z_revert(96,2.5)&trend_regime_1h(24) net 12.6 bp at 120 min, n=678; unfiltered (96,2.5) info horizon rising to 240
proposed_test: Derived campaign in family liq_meanrev: entry fixed to the screened window-96 configs, time-dominated exits (SL 6 ATR, TP 6 ATR, hold 120/240); refuted if Dev Sharpe stays < 1 and G4 rolling fraction < 0.6.
reexamine_if: leave-year-out shows one year carries the result

text: Breakout of the 1-day high on Coinone 5m has statistically detectable but economically thin information (screen net 2-3.5 bp, info horizon 15 min); as a strategy it is essentially break-even (Dev Sharpe_w 0.04, neighbour exit variants negative at -0.86), so the edge is eaten by cost plus exit slippage - the taxonomy says PARAM_SPIKE but the substance is closer to COST_EATEN.
evidence: fact-000006 candidates[0]: sharpe_w 0.041, G3 neighbor_median -0.864, G5 dsr 0.194
fact-000003 (screen camp-000003): shorter lookbacks 48/96 all failed on net cost; donchian 288 net 1.95 bp, with vol_regime 3.52 bp at 30 min
proposed_test: Screen (family vol_breakout) of donchian_breakout(288) with vol_regime min_pct 0.8 (block-grid value): refuted as a 'high-vol concentration' story if net mean at 60-120 min is not >= 2x the 0.67 filter's.

text: The trend-filtered 96-bar Bollinger reversion (z 2.5 + trend_regime_1h 24) does not look like steady liquidity-provision income. It behaves like bull-regime dip buying. Its Dev PnL is concentrated in 2021 and in up-trend 30d regimes, sideways regimes lose money, and the alpha vs BTC is not significant. Because the edge lives in a few regime-specific periods, Dev Sharpe stays near 1 (weighted about 0.57) whatever the exits, and DSR stays below 0.95.
evidence: fact-000008 candidates: trend spec 7cf92d03f9 sharpe 1.055 / sharpe_w 0.571, G4 rolling 0.64, G5 dsr 0.872 (n_trials 15), skew 2.41, kurtosis 44.5; unfiltered 728b01519b sharpe_w 0.594, rolling 0.45

Alternatively, a pre-registered screen in family liq_meanrev that pairs the entry with a vol/trend-strength filter, testing whether the edge is conditional on regime rather than on the dislocation.
